candidates.description: This feature vector represents sports, particularly team games and athletic terminology.
This vector activates on prefixes and roots related to international, internal, and interactive concepts.
This vector activates strongly for words and subwords starting with the prefix "pro-" across various languages and contexts.
This feature vector activates on words related to sports statistics, scoring plays, and athletic movement.
This vector represents common Portuguese function words and grammatical markers.
This vector represents action verbs expressing logical relationships, conditions, or states of being.
This vector represents numeric digits, quantities, and indefinite determiners across multiple languages.
These tokens represent common syllable or phonetic sounds, particularly syllables starting with consonant-vowel combinations in Latin-based alphabets.
This feature vector activates strongly in response to numbers in the high one-hundreds range.
This feature vector activates strongly on adverbs and adverbial suffixes indicating degree, manner, or frequency in Romance languages like Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese.
